boards.title: What the Campus Tour Skips: 10 Places Students Share With Each Other
boards.description: Ten named Canisius destinations with documented student study, gathering, dining, cultural, or support uses.

cards.title: Andrew L. Bouwhuis Library
cards.subtitle: Campus library study space
cards.notes: Start here when you need a campus-based study setting; the Golisano Center lists the library among additional places students can study.
cards.short_summary: A named campus library included in Canisius’s list of student study locations.
cards.evidence_claim: Canisius identifies the Library as an additional place for students to study on campus.
cards.access_notes: Use during regular library operating hours; check the library for current access details.

cards.title: Bouwhuis Library Study Rooms
cards.subtitle: Andrew L. Bouwhuis Library
cards.notes: Reserve one of the library’s study rooms when your group needs a defined workspace or you need to join a synchronous online session.
cards.short_summary: Twelve reservable library rooms for study and synchronous online learning.
cards.evidence_claim: Canisius states that 12 Library study rooms are available for reservation during regular Library operating hours.
cards.access_notes: Reservation is required; rooms are available during regular Library operating hours.

cards.title: Study Center
cards.subtitle: Golisano Center for Student Success, Room 208
cards.notes: Use this quiet Golisano 208 study setting for focused reading or coursework, then visit nearby support offices if you need help.
cards.short_summary: A quiet, named study area within the Golisano Center.
cards.evidence_claim: Canisius describes the Study Center in Golisano 208 as a quiet place for students to read or study.
cards.access_notes: Campus student space; confirm building access and availability before visiting.

cards.title: Tutoring Center
cards.subtitle: Golisano Center for Student Success, Room 209
cards.notes: Pair a study session with academic assistance by checking the Tutoring Center in Golisano 209 and its current appointment options.
cards.short_summary: A named academic-support space listed alongside campus study locations.
cards.evidence_claim: Canisius lists the Tutoring Center in Golisano 209 as an additional place for students to study.
cards.access_notes: Academic-support space; verify current tutoring availability and building access.

cards.entity_name: Chester HON ’01 and Diane Stranczek Commons
cards.title: Stranczek Commons
cards.subtitle: Science Hall
cards.notes: Plan daytime study in this Science Hall commons, then account for its switch to event use later in the day.
cards.short_summary: A Science Hall gathering room with documented student-use and study periods.
cards.evidence_claim: Canisius lists Science Hall Commons for study from 8:30 a.m. to 4 p.m. and describes the Stranczek Commons as a multi-purpose student gathering space.
cards.access_notes: Study availability is listed as 8:30 a.m.–4 p.m.; it is used for events afterward.

cards.title: Science Hall Atrium
cards.subtitle: Science Hall
cards.notes: Use the atrium as an on-campus study stop between classes, keeping in mind that building access and activity can vary.
cards.short_summary: A named Science Hall study location on the university’s current resource list.
cards.evidence_claim: Canisius includes the Science Hall Atrium in its list of additional places for students to study on campus.
cards.access_notes: Confirm current building access and room conditions before relying on it for a long session.

cards.title: Winter Student Center
cards.subtitle: Campus student-life and event venue
cards.notes: Meet classmates here for a campus program, club meeting, or meal; the building combines dining, lounges, meeting rooms, and event areas.
cards.short_summary: A named student center with multiple documented gathering and event venues.
cards.evidence_claim: Canisius says the Winter Student Center includes Economou Dining Hall, Grupp Fireside Lounge, Regis Room, and venues for meetings, workshops, lectures, and receptions.
cards.access_notes: Some rooms may be scheduled for events; check the Office of Event Services for availability.

cards.title: Economou Dining Hall
cards.subtitle: First floor, Winter Student Center
cards.notes: Use the first-floor dining hall for a campus meal or to meet around mealtime; confirm current dining service and payment options first.
cards.short_summary: Canisius’s documented main on-campus dining hall.
cards.evidence_claim: Canisius identifies Economou Dining Hall on the first floor of the Student Center as the main dining hall on campus.
cards.access_notes: Dining service, payment, and access are subject to the university’s current operations.

cards.title: Grupp Fireside Lounge
cards.subtitle: Winter Student Center
cards.notes: Choose this named Student Center lounge as a meeting point, while checking whether an event has reserved the space before you settle in.
cards.short_summary: A documented lounge venue within the Winter Student Center.
cards.evidence_claim: Canisius identifies Grupp Fireside Lounge as one of the venues in the Richard E. Winter ’42 Student Center.
cards.access_notes: May be used for scheduled meetings or events; verify availability locally.

cards.title: Montante Cultural Center
cards.subtitle: Campus cultural and academic event venue
cards.notes: Check the campus calendar for a lecture, concert, or performance, and plan this as a meeting point before attending a scheduled program.
cards.short_summary: A named campus home for ArtsCanisius and university musical groups.
cards.evidence_claim: Canisius states that the Montante Cultural Center hosts cultural and academic events and is home to ArtsCanisius and the university’s musical groups.
cards.access_notes: Attendance and access depend on the scheduled program; review the relevant event details.
